name.en: Clark V Playground: Sun and Shade
name.pt: Parque Infantil Clark V: Sol e Sombra

short_description.en: Modern playground equipped with slides, climbing structures, and shaded rest zones under tall trees.
short_description.pt: Parque moderno equipado com escorregas, estruturas de escalada e zonas de descanso à sombra de árvores.

full_description.en: Clark V Playground features certified safety rubber flooring, multiple slides, and tree canopy providing solar shade during afternoon hours. Ideal for families and toddlers.
full_description.pt: O Parque Clark V tem pavimento de borracha certificado, vários escorregas e árvores com sombra à tarde. Ideal para famílias e crianças pequenas.
